title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
title_zh: 用于自动调优专业神经网络模型的多智能体大语言模型系统

paragraphs.en: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles—analyst, coder, and recorder —with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks—spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky (KS) equations—the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.
paragraphs.zh: 许多机器学习方法都是两层的：专家首先选择一类方法，而在这类方法中，关键组件的选择至关重要，且通常是手动完成的。 本文致力于解决这些组件的自动调优问题，并提出一个可在不同性质模型间迁移使用的框架。 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架包含三个角色——分析员、编码员和记录员——并配有实验日志和沙盒执行环境。 与那些在离散空间中优化整个机器学习脚本或搜索架构的系统不同，该框架在一个开放但语义狭窄的空间中运行：智能体仅针对指定的组件生成代码，而整体网络结构保持不变。 该方法通过两个方向进行了验证：使用相关性学习对分类脉冲神经网络进行调优，以及利用物理感知神经网络（PINN）求解高阶微分方程。 在五个任务中——MNIST和Digits数据集上的脉冲分类，以及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和Kuramoto–Sivashinsky（KS）方程的边界值问题——该智能体的表现优于基线模型：分类准确率分别提高了13个百分点（MNIST）和6个百分点（Digits）；与解析单孤子解相比，误差降低了约2491倍；在选定的GNLSE运行中，使用高斯扰动时，不变量保持误差降低了约325倍，而在重复初始化的平均情况下则降低了超过100倍；对于KS问题，使用高斯扰动时，质量漂移降低了14倍。 因此，该框架能够在不改变其内部结构的前提下，对性质不同的任务中的关键组件进行调优。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of a new class of tools —agent systems that can not only respond to queries but also plan actions, use tools, execute code, and accumulate experience from previous steps Xi et al. (2023) ; Yao et al. (2023b) . Such agents are already used in programming, ML engineering, and individual scientific disciplines Jimenez et al. (2024) ; Chan et al. (2024) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Schmidgall et al. (2025) ; however, their use as a meta-optimizer for specialized neural network models remains understudied. A detailed review of related work is given in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为一类新工具的基础——智能体系统，这类系统不仅能响应查询，还能规划行动、使用工具、执行代码，并从先前步骤中积累经验 Xi et al. (2023) ; Yao et al. (2023b) 。 此类智能体已被用于编程、机器学习工程以及各个科学领域 Jimenez et al. (2024) ; Chan et al. (2024) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Schmidgall et al. (2025) ; 然而，将其用作专用神经网络模型的元优化器的应用仍研究不足。 相关工作的详细综述见第 2 节。

paragraphs.en: The quality of specialized neural network models depends strongly on the task: the representation of inputs and outputs, the method for decoding internal activity, the balance of loss-function terms, and other components must be selected anew for each problem, and no universal selection rule exists. In practice, this selection is performed manually, which makes the process labor-intensive and poorly reproducible. At the same time, models of different types can be decomposed into similar modules: input encoding and preprocessing, a trainable feature transformation, a decoding or output transformation, and a loss function. The tuning task is therefore reduced not to redesigning the entire network for every new problem but to modifying its individual modules, which enables a single tuning procedure applicable to models of different types.
paragraphs.zh: 专用神经网络模型的质量在很大程度上取决于具体任务：输入和输出的表示方式、内部活动解码的方法、损失函数各项之间的平衡以及其他组件都必须针对每个问题重新选择，且并不存在通用的选择规则。 在实际应用中，这种选择是手动完成的，这使得整个过程劳动密集且难以重复实现。 同时，不同类型的模型都可以分解为类似的模块：输入编码与预处理、可训练的特征转换、解码或输出转换，以及损失函数。 因此，调优任务不再需要为每个新问题重新设计整个网络，而只需修改其各个模块，这使得一种单一的调优流程能够适用于不同类型的模型。

paragraphs.en: Studies in which LLM agents are used as a general tool for automatic tuning of individual functional blocks of a model with a fixed architecture and training procedure are almost absent from the open literature (see Section 2 ). Existing systems focus either on programming tasks and the general ML cycle or on constructing a network from a textual task description. In contrast, the proposed framework does not build a network but modifies its predefined blocks using a single agent interaction pattern that does not depend on the particular application task.
paragraphs.zh: 在公开文献中，几乎没有研究将 LLM 智能体用作通用工具，对具有固定架构和训练流程的模型中的各个功能模块进行自动调整（参见第 2 节）。 现有系统要么专注于编程任务和通用的机器学习周期，要么专注于根据文本任务描述构建网络。 相比之下，所提出的框架并不构建网络，而是通过一种不依赖于具体应用任务的单一智能体交互模式来修改其预定义模块。

paragraphs.en: We propose a multi-agent LLM framework for the automatic tuning of individual functional blocks of a neural network model (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种多智能体大语言模型框架，用于自动调整神经网络模型中各个功能模块（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We show that the same framework transfers across five tasks with different types of information representation without changes to its internal structure (Section 5 , Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，无需改变其内部结构，同一框架即可迁移到五种不同类型的信息表示任务中（第 5 节，表 1）。

paragraphs.en: We show that a detailed prompt improves the performance of less capable LLMs, bringing it closer to that of more advanced models (Section 5.2 , Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，使用详细的提示能够提升能力较弱的 LLM 的性能，使其更接近更先进模型的水平（第 5.2 节，表 2）。

paragraphs.en: The multi-agent framework improves the baseline models: on the spiking neural network (SNN) tasks (Tables 2 and 19 ), accuracy increases by 13% on MNIST and by 6% on the scikit-learn digits; on the physics-informed neural network (PINN) tasks (Section 5.4 – 5.6 ), the relative error decreases approximately 2500-fold for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) problem with a known analytical solution, and for problems without analytical solutions, the conservation error decreases approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE soliton–Gaussian run (more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations) and the mass drift decreases 14-fold for the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky (KS) wave with a Gaussian perturbation.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体框架提升了基线模型的性能：在脉冲神经网络（SNN）任务中（表2和表19），MNIST数据集的准确率提高了13%，scikit-learn digits数据集的准确率提高了6%；在物理信息神经网络（PINN）任务中（第5.4–5.6节），对于具有已知解析解的广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）问题，相对误差降低了约2500倍；而对于没有解析解的问题，在选定的GNLSE孤子–高斯运行中，守恒误差降低了约325倍（在重复初始化的平均情况下超过100倍），且带有高斯扰动的Kuramoto–Sivashinsky（KS）波的质心漂移降低了14倍。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents can autonomously plan actions, use tools, and accumulate knowledge while solving multi-step tasks Xi et al. (2023) . The ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) pattern has become a baseline architecture Yao et al. (2023b) . Recent surveys Guo et al. (2024) ; Huang et al. (2024) identify typical components: a planning module (Chain-of-Thought Wei et al. (2022) , Tree-of-Thoughts Yao et al. (2023a) ), dynamic memory and self-reflection Shinn et al. (2023) , calls to external tools, and multi-agent designs with role separation Chen et al. (2024) . When agents act as meta-optimizers of neural network models, three of these components are essential: role separation distinguishes hypothesis formulation from its software implementation; logged memory prevents rejected variants from being proposed again; and a sandboxed execution environment is required to run generated code safely.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents have been applied to a diverse set of tasks. SWE-bench Jimenez et al. (2024) and MLE-Bench Chan et al. (2024) have become standard benchmarks for programming and automated ML: the medal rate of the first published o1-preview configuration with AIDE was 16.9 % Chan et al. (2024) , while later agents increased this value to 64 % of medals on MLE-Bench Lite (MLE-STAR Nam et al. (2026) , including 36 % gold medals) and to approximately 35 % across all difficulty levels (R&D-Agent on GPT-5) Yang et al. (2025) . Similar multi-agent designs are used in materials discovery and biochemistry Takahara et al. (2025) ; Shi et al. (2026) ; Ghafarollahi and Buehler (2024) ; Swanson et al. (2025) . Voyager Wang et al. (2023) demonstrates lifelong accumulation of a skill library in the form of executable code, which is close to the idea of logged hypotheses used in this work. Systems for automating the scientific cycle (The AI Scientist Lu et al. (2024) ; Yamada et al. (2025) , Agent Laboratory Schmidgall et al. (2025) ) and agent-based robot control Skorokhodov et al. (2025) have been developed in parallel; they show that autonomous research is possible in principle but do not incorporate domain-specific knowledge of PINNs or SNNs.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体已被应用于多种多样的任务。SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）和 MLE-Bench（Chan 等人，2024）已成为编程和自动化机器学习领域的标准基准：首个发布的 o1-preview 配置与 AIDE 结合使用时，其奖牌获得率为 16.9%（Chan 等人，2024），而后续的智能体将这一比例提升至 MLE-Bench Lite 上的 64%（MLE-STAR，Nam 等人，2026，其中包括 36% 的金牌），并在所有难度级别上达到了约 35%（R&D-Agent 在 GPT-5 上的表现，Yang 等人，2025）。类似的多智能体设计也应用于材料发现和生物化学领域（Takahara 等人，2025；Shi 等人，2026；Ghafarollahi 和 Buehler，2024；Swanson 等人，2025）。Voyager（Wang 等人，2023）展示了以可执行代码形式实现技能库的终身积累，这与本研究中所使用的已记录假设的概念相近。自动化科学循环的系统（The AI Scientist，Lu 等人，2024；Yamada 等人，2025；Agent Laboratory，Schmidgall 等人，2025）以及基于智能体的机器人控制系统（Skorokhodov 等人，2025）也在同步开发中；这些系统表明自主研究在原则上是可行的，但并未融入 PINNs 或 SNNs 的领域特定知识。

paragraphs.en: PINN quality depends on the choice of architecture, activations, the balance of loss-function terms, the distribution of collocation points, and the representation of inputs and outputs Moloshnikov et al. (2025b) ; separate heuristics have been proposed for each component, but no unified automatic procedure has been established. Lang-PINN He et al. (2025) , the study closest to the agent-based approach, constructs a PINN from a textual task description but focuses on network construction rather than on selecting its functional blocks for a physical problem.
paragraphs.zh: PINN 的质量取决于架构、激活函数的选择、损失函数各项之间的平衡、配点分布，以及输入和输出的表示方式 Moloshnikov et al. (2025b)；虽然针对每个组件都提出了独立的启发式方法，但尚未建立统一的自动化流程。Lang-PINN He et al. (2025)，这项研究最接近基于智能体的方法，它根据文本任务描述构建 PINN，但重点在于网络构造，而非为物理问题选择其功能模块。

sents.en: PINN quality depends on the choice of architecture, activations, the balance of loss-function terms, the distribution of collocation points, and the representation of inputs and outputs Moloshnikov et al.

paragraphs.en: For SNNs, automatic approaches to selecting the architecture and its individual blocks rely on evolutionary algorithms and reinforcement learning Kim et al. (2022) ; Na et al. (2022) ; formally, neural architecture search (NAS) also includes the generation of individual functional modules within a predefined space of architectural variants. Unlike NAS, the proposed approach uses an LLM, exploits domain knowledge and knowledge of model properties, locally modifies a selected module of an existing network without searching a fixed space of variants, and stores the history of hypotheses in natural language, so that each subsequent iteration can use a substantive analysis of previous iterations rather than only their numerical results.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 SNN，选择其架构及各个模块的自动化方法依赖于进化算法和强化学习 Kim et al. (2022) ; Na et al. (2022) ; 从形式上看，神经架构搜索（NAS）还包括在预定义的架构变体空间中生成单个功能模块。 与 NAS 不同，所提出的方法使用 LLM，利用领域知识和模型属性知识，在不搜索固定变体空间的情况下局部修改现有网络中选定的模块，并以自然语言存储假设的历史记录，这样每次后续迭代都可以对前几次迭代进行实质性分析，而不仅仅是使用它们的数值结果。

paragraphs.en: To the authors’ knowledge, the open literature contains no work in which LLM agents are used as a general tool for automatically tuning individual functional blocks of neural network models without redesigning the network itself. MLE-STAR Nam et al. (2026) is the closest agent system; the similarity is limited to two components: logged experiment memory and a sandboxed execution environment. MLE-STAR applies iterative code modifications with an update only when the metric improves on the outer loop, processes the entire ML script, selects the target block with a separate agent, assigns web search to a separate retriever agent, and involves more than ten agents.
paragraphs.zh: 据作者所知，公开文献中尚无任何研究将 LLM 智能体用作通用工具，在无需重新设计神经网络本身的情况下自动调整神经网络模型的各个功能模块。MLE-STAR Nam et al. (2026) 是最接近的智能体系统；其相似性仅限于两个组件：记录实验日志的记忆库和沙盒执行环境。 MLE-STAR 采用迭代代码修改，仅当外层循环中的指标改善时才会进行更新；它处理整个机器学习脚本，通过一个独立的智能体选择目标模块，将网络搜索任务分配给一个独立的检索智能体，并涉及超过十个智能体。

paragraphs.en: The framework optimizes a selected functional block while keeping the rest of the task pipeline fixed. Before a run, the Human Researcher specifies the task, the block that the agents may modify, the evaluation metric, the software contract for the generated code, and a baseline. These settings allow the same framework to be applied to different problems without changing its architecture or execution loop.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架在保持任务流程其余部分不变的同时，对选定的功能模块进行优化。 在执行之前，人类研究人员需要指定任务、智能体可以修改的模块、评估指标、生成代码的软件合同以及一个基准。 这些设置使得相同的框架能够在不改变其架构或执行循环的情况下应用于不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: The framework is built on top of an OpenAI-compatible API and separates hypothesis generation, software implementation, and experiment documentation into three LLM roles. A sandboxed execution environment and an external experiment log close the iterative loop (Fig. 1 ). The framework consists of five main components:
paragraphs.zh: 该框架构建在兼容 OpenAI 的 API 之上，并将假设生成、软件实现和实验文档分为三个 LLM 角色。 一个沙盒执行环境与一个外部实验日志共同构成了迭代循环（图 1）。 该框架由五个主要组件组成：

sents.en: The framework is built on top of an OpenAI-compatible API and separates hypothesis generation, software implementation, and experiment documentation into three LLM roles.
sents.zh: 该框架构建在兼容 OpenAI 的 API 之上，并将假设生成、软件实现和实验文档分为三个 LLM 角色。

sents.en: A sandboxed execution environment and an external experiment log close the iterative loop (Fig. 1 ).
sents.zh: 一个沙盒执行环境与一个外部实验日志共同构成了迭代循环（图 1）。

sents.en: The framework consists of five main components:
sents.zh: 该框架由五个主要组件组成：

paragraphs.en: LLM Analyst receives the task prompt and the current experiment log. It proposes one hypothesis for the agent-modifiable block and expresses the idea as a technical specification with a fixed structure. If the Human Researcher provides a taxonomy of method classes, the Analyst also assigns the hypothesis to one of these classes.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 分析师接收任务提示和当前实验日志。 它针对智能体可修改的模块提出一个假设，并以固定结构的技术规范形式表达该想法。 如果人类研究员提供了方法类的分类体系，分析师还会将该假设归入其中一个类别。

sents.en: LLM Analyst receives the task prompt and the current experiment log.
sents.zh: LLM 分析师接收任务提示和当前实验日志。

sents.en: It proposes one hypothesis for the agent-modifiable block and expresses the idea as a technical specification with a fixed structure.
sents.zh: 它针对智能体可修改的模块提出一个假设，并以固定结构的技术规范形式表达该想法。

sents.en: If the Human Researcher provides a taxonomy of method classes, the Analyst also assigns the hypothesis to one of these classes.
sents.zh: 如果人类研究员提供了方法类的分类体系，分析师还会将该假设归入其中一个类别。

paragraphs.en: LLM Coder translates the technical specification into Python code. In addition to implementing the proposed method, the code must satisfy a task-specific software contract that defines the allowed dependencies, class names, call signatures, input and output shapes, and trainable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: LLM Coder 将技术规格翻译成 Python 代码。 除了实现所提出的方法外，该代码还必须满足一项任务特定的软件合同，该合同定义了允许的依赖项、类名、调用签名、输入和输出形状以及可训练参数。

sents.en: LLM Coder translates the technical specification into Python code.
sents.zh: LLM Coder 将技术规格翻译成 Python 代码。

sents.en: In addition to implementing the proposed method, the code must satisfy a task-specific software contract that defines the allowed dependencies, class names, call signatures, input and output shapes, and trainable parameters.

paragraphs.en: Sandboxed execution environment (Docker) inserts the generated module into the fixed task pipeline, first performs a short functional test, and then evaluates a valid candidate. A runtime error is returned to the LLM Coder for correction, whereas the metric from a successful run is passed to the logging stage.
paragraphs.zh: 沙盒执行环境（Docker）将生成的模块插入到固定的任务流程中，首先进行简短的功能测试，然后评估一个有效的候选方案。 如果发生运行时错误，则返回给 LLM Coder 进行修正；而成功运行的指标则会传递到日志记录阶段。

sents.en: Sandboxed execution environment (Docker) inserts the generated module into the fixed task pipeline, first performs a short functional test, and then evaluates a valid candidate.
sents.zh: 沙盒执行环境（Docker）将生成的模块插入到固定的任务流程中，首先进行简短的功能测试，然后评估一个有效的候选方案。

paragraphs.zh: LLM Recorder 将规范、验证过的代码和评估结果汇总为结构化的 JSON 记录，其中包含方法名称、简短描述以及最终的超参数。

paragraphs.zh: 由框架分配的运行标识符；

paragraphs.en: the experiment name and a short description generated by the LLM Recorder from the technical specification and validated code;
paragraphs.zh: 实验名称以及由 LLM Recorder 根据技术规格和验证过的代码生成的简短描述；

paragraphs.en: the execution status assigned by the control loop from the functional-test and evaluation outcomes;
paragraphs.zh: 由功能测试和评估结果中控制循环分配的执行状态；

paragraphs.en: the resulting target-metric value computed by the task-specific evaluation procedure for a successfully evaluated candidate;
paragraphs.zh: 通过任务特定的评估程序对成功评估的候选项计算出的最终目标指标值；

paragraphs.en: the method class selected by the LLM Analyst when a task-specific taxonomy is used;
paragraphs.zh: 当使用任务特定的分类体系时，由 LLM 分析师选定的方法类；

paragraphs.en: the final hyperparameter values extracted by the LLM Recorder from the validated generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 由 LLM Recorder 从经过验证的生成代码中提取的最终超参数值。

paragraphs.en: Records with the With error status remain stored in the complete experiment log. Before the log is included in the Analyst prompt, the framework filters out these records, so the Analyst receives the baseline and successfully evaluated records only. The run budget counts only successfully evaluated records with the OK status.

paragraphs.en: The technical specification describes the method proposed by the Analyst, whereas the software contract defines the interface and constraints for the generated code. The agents may modify only the selected block; the rest of the task pipeline remains fixed. This separation allows generated code to be inserted and tested automatically. Applying the framework to a new task requires a new prompt, software contract, target metric, and baseline, but the agent roles and execution loop remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 技术规格描述了分析师提出的方法，而软件合同则界定了生成代码的接口和约束条件。 智能体只能修改选中的代码块；任务流程的其他部分保持不变。 这种分离使得生成的代码能够被自动插入和测试。 将框架应用于新任务需要新的提示、软件合同、目标指标和基线，但智能体的角色和执行循环保持不变。

sents.en: The technical specification describes the method proposed by the Analyst, whereas the software contract defines the interface and constraints for the generated code.
sents.zh: 技术规格描述了分析师提出的方法，而软件合同则界定了生成代码的接口和约束条件。

sents.en: The agents may modify only the selected block; the rest of the task pipeline remains fixed.
sents.zh: 智能体只能修改选中的代码块；任务流程的其他部分保持不变。

sents.en: This separation allows generated code to be inserted and tested automatically.
sents.zh: 这种分离使得生成的代码能够被自动插入和测试。

sents.en: Applying the framework to a new task requires a new prompt, software contract, target metric, and baseline, but the agent roles and execution loop remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 将框架应用于新任务需要新的提示、软件合同、目标指标和基线，但智能体的角色和执行循环保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Each framework run starts with a task-specific baseline record in the experiment log. This record evaluates the fixed pipeline with the simple baseline implementation of the modifiable block and provides the initial reference value of the target metric. The baseline implementations used in this study are defined in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 每次框架运行都以实验日志中的一项任务特定基线记录开始。 该记录评估了固定流程与可修改模块的简单基线实现，并提供了目标指标的最初参考值。 本研究使用的基线实现定义在第 4 节中。

sents.zh: 每次框架运行都以实验日志中的一项任务特定基线记录开始。

sents.en: The baseline implementations used in this study are defined in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 本研究使用的基线实现定义在第 4 节中。

paragraphs.en: The framework supports two modes of hypothesis generation. The standard prompt contains the Analyst role, problem statement, target metric, implementation constraints, required format of the technical specification, and complete experiment log.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架支持两种假设生成模式。 标准提示词包含分析师角色、问题陈述、目标指标、实施约束、技术规格所需格式以及完整的实验日志。

sents.en: The framework supports two modes of hypothesis generation.
sents.zh: 该框架支持两种假设生成模式。

sents.en: The standard prompt contains the Analyst role, problem statement, target metric, implementation constraints, required format of the technical specification, and complete experiment log.
sents.zh: 标准提示词包含分析师角色、问题陈述、目标指标、实施约束、技术规格所需格式以及完整的实验日志。

paragraphs.en: The detailed prompt retains these elements and adds a structured Chain-of-Thought procedure and a list of method classes specified by the Human Researcher for systematic exploration. Each hypothesis is assigned to one principal class, which is also stored in its experiment-log record, and the log is converted into a dynamically updated coverage map . For every class, the map reports the number of evaluated hypotheses, the best metric value, and a coverage status such as “not explored,” “limited data,” or “explored.” The map is included in the next Analyst prompt, which prioritizes suitable classes with little or no coverage and revisits an explored class only when a substantially different hypothesis is proposed. This mechanism structures an open natural-language search without reducing it to a finite list of implementations. The task-specific prompt configurations are described in Section 4 ; the detailed-mode prompt materials are provided in Supplementary Materials.
paragraphs.zh: 详细提示保留了这些要素，并增加了一个结构化的链式思维流程，以及由人类研究员指定的方法类列表，以进行系统性探索。 每个假设都被分配给一个主类，该主类也存储在其实验日志记录中，并且日志会被转换为一个动态更新的覆盖范围图。 对于每个类别，该地图会报告已评估的假设数量、最佳指标值以及覆盖状态（例如“未探索”“数据有限”或“已探索”）。该地图会被包含在下一个分析师提示中，后者会优先处理覆盖范围较少或没有覆盖的合适类别，并且只有在提出一个有显著差异的假设时才会重新审视一个已探索的类别。 这种机制将开放的自然语言搜索结构化，而不会将其简化为有限的实现列表。 特定任务的提示配置在第 4 节中进行了描述；详细模式的提示材料则提供在补充材料中。

sents.en: One framework run is a series with a task-specific number of successful iterations.
sents.zh: 一次框架运行是一个系列，其中包含特定于任务的成功迭代次数。

sents.en: At each iteration, one hypothesis is tested in six steps:
sents.zh: 在每次迭代中，一个假设会通过六个步骤进行测试：

paragraphs.en: The Analyst receives the task prompt and the current experiment log. At the first iteration, the log contains only the baseline record. In detailed mode, the current coverage map is generated from the log and included in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 分析员接收任务提示和当前的实验日志。 在第一次迭代中，日志仅包含基线记录。 在详细模式下，当前的覆盖图根据日志生成并包含在提示中。

sents.en: The Analyst receives the task prompt and the current experiment log.
sents.zh: 分析员接收任务提示和当前的实验日志。

sents.en: At the first iteration, the log contains only the baseline record.
sents.zh: 在第一次迭代中，日志仅包含基线记录。

sents.en: In detailed mode, the current coverage map is generated from the log and included in the prompt.
sents.zh: 在详细模式下，当前的覆盖图根据日志生成并包含在提示中。

paragraphs.en: The Analyst creates a technical specification according to the prompt template. In detailed mode, the specification also identifies the method class.
paragraphs.zh: 分析师根据提示模板创建技术规格。 在详细模式下，该规格还会确定方法类。

sents.en: The Analyst creates a technical specification according to the prompt template.
sents.zh: 分析师根据提示模板创建技术规格。

sents.en: In detailed mode, the specification also identifies the method class.
sents.zh: 在详细模式下，该规格还会确定方法类。

paragraphs.en: The Coder implements the specification subject to the corresponding software contract.
paragraphs.zh: Coder 在遵守相应软件合同的前提下实现该规范。

paragraphs.en: The code undergoes an automatic functional test on a small sample in the sandboxed environment. If the test fails, the error message, generated code, and original specification are returned to the Coder. The Coder analyzes the reported error and rewrites the code while preserving the proposed method and software contract; the revised version is then tested again. If valid code cannot be obtained within 10 attempts, the experiment is assigned the With error status; it does not count toward the run budget, and the framework proceeds to a new hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 该代码在沙盒环境中对一个小样本进行自动功能测试。 如果测试失败，错误信息、生成的代码以及原始规范将被返回给编码智能体。 编码智能体会分析报告中的错误，并在保留所提议的方法和软件契约的同时重写代码；随后会对修订后的版本再次进行测试。 如果在 10 次尝试内无法获得有效的代码，该实验将被赋予“存在错误”的状态；这不会计入运行预算，框架将继续进入新的假设阶段。

sents.en: If valid code cannot be obtained within 10 attempts, the experiment is assigned the With error status; it does not count toward the run budget, and the framework proceeds to a new hypothesis.
sents.zh: 如果在 10 次尝试内无法获得有效的代码，该实验将被赋予“存在错误”的状态；这不会计入运行预算，框架将继续进入新的假设阶段。

paragraphs.en: Code that passes the functional test is evaluated according to the task-specific evaluation protocol, and the resulting metric is assigned the OK status. The budgets, metrics, data-use rules, and repetition schemes used in this study are specified in Section 4.5 and the accompanying appendices.
paragraphs.zh: 通过功能测试的代码将根据特定任务的评估协议进行评估，并将所得指标标记为“通过”状态。 本研究使用的预算、指标、数据使用规则和重复方案在第 4.5 节及随附的附录中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: The Recorder combines the specification, validated code, execution result, and fitted hyperparameters into a JSON record and appends it to the log. The updated log becomes the external memory for the next iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 记录器将规范、验证过的代码、执行结果和拟合好的超参数整合为一个 JSON 记录，并将其追加到日志中。 更新后的日志将成为下一轮迭代的外部记忆。

paragraphs.en: The same framework is applied to five tasks with different types of information representation: two spiking-network classification tasks, two boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation, and one boundary-value problem for the generalized Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation.
paragraphs.zh: 同一框架被应用于五个具有不同信息表示类型的任务：两个脉冲网络分类任务、两个广义非线性薛定谔方程的边界值问题，以及一个广义仓本-西瓦申斯基方程的边界值问题。

paragraphs.en: The classifier is based on a Correlation Classwise Network (CCN) spiking neural network Sboev et al. (2025) ; Kunitsyn et al. (2025) , whose weights are trained using a local spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. Image pixels are normalized and encoded as correlated spike trains that serve as the network input. The output spike activity of the leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons is then translated into a class label by the decoding module. The fixed part , which the framework cannot modify, comprises the input encoding, the CCN, and the recorded output activity vector 𝐫 ∈ ℝ K \mathbf{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{K} ; the agent-modifiable part is the Decoder ⁡ ( 𝐫 ) \mathrm{Decoder}(\mathbf{r}) module (Fig. 2 ). Its software contract permits fitting parameters from training activity and class labels but prohibits modifying the trained SNN, spike encoding, or recorded activity and prohibits error backpropagation. The decoder must return one valid class label per sample. We evaluate the method on two datasets: MNIST LeCun et al. (1998) ( 28 × 28 28\times 28 images, N = 784 N=784 spike generators) and the scikit-learn digits dataset Pedregosa et al. (2011) ( 8 × 8 8\times 8 , N = 64 N=64 ). Both contain 10 classes, so the network has K = 10 K=10 output LIF neurons. Accuracy is used as the target metric. As a baseline , we use an arg ⁡ max \arg\max decoder: the predicted class corresponds to the output neuron with the highest spike rate. Candidate selection uses only development data; the held-out test sets are unavailable to the agents, as detailed in Section B.1 . Full details of the SNN model, the encoding scheme, the STDP rule, and the hyperparameters are given in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 该分类器基于一种相关性类间网络（CCN）的脉冲神经网络（Sboev et al. (2025)；Kunitsyn et al. (2025)，其权重通过局部脉冲时间依赖可塑性（STDP）规则进行训练。 图像像素经过归一化，并被编码为相关的脉冲序列，作为网络的输入。 随后，漏积分-放电（LIF）神经元的输出脉冲活动由解码模块转换为类别标签。 框架无法修改的固定部分包括输入编码、CCN以及记录的输出活动向量 𝐫 ∈ ℝ K \mathbf{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{K}；而智能体可修改的部分是 Decoder ⁡ ( 𝐫 ) \mathrm{Decoder}(\mathbf{r}) 模块（图2）。 其软件合同允许根据训练活动和类别标签拟合参数，但禁止修改已训练的脉冲神经网络（SNN）、脉冲编码或记录的活动，也禁止错误反向传播。 解码器必须为每个样本返回一个有效的类别标签。 我们在两个数据集上评估了该方法：MNIST（LeCun et al. (1998)（28 × 28 28\times 28 图像，N = 784 N=784 个脉冲生成器）以及 scikit-learn digits 数据集（Pedregosa et al. (2011)（8 × 8 8\times 8，N = 64 N=64））。 这两个数据集都包含10个类别，因此网络有 K = 10 K=10 个输出 LIF 神经元。 准确率被用作目标指标。 作为基线方法，我们使用一个 arg ⁡ max \arg\max 解码器：预测类别对应于脉冲率最高的输出神经元。 候选选择仅使用开发数据；预留的测试集对智能体不可用，具体细节见 B.1 节。 SNN 模型、编码方案、STDP 规则及超参数的完整细节见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: The fixed part comprises the multilayer perceptron (MLP) architecture, loss functional, and training procedure. The agent-modifiable part comprises two transformations (Fig. 4 ): the input transformation F I F_{I} , which maps the coordinates ( x , t ) (x,t) to the MLP input features, and the output transformation F O F_{O} , which maps the MLP outputs and coordinates to the predicted physical field. For the GNLSE problems, the prediction consists of the two real components ( u , v ) (u,v) ; for the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky problem, it is the single real field u u . The agents may change the mathematical forms of F I F_{I} and F O F_{O} and may increase the intermediate MLP output dimension when required by F O F_{O} , but cannot modify the remaining architecture, loss functional, or training procedure. In the baseline , F I F_{I} passes ( x , t ) (x,t) to the MLP unchanged and F O F_{O} returns the raw MLP outputs. The framework is applied to two boundary-value problems for ( 1 ), which differ in the initial condition, domain, and target metric, and to one boundary-value problem for ( 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 固定部分包括多层感知器（MLP）架构、损失函数和训练流程。 智能体可修改的部分包括两种变换（图4）：输入变换 F I F_{I}，它将坐标 (x,t) 映射到 MLP 输入特征；以及输出变换 F O F_{O}，它将 MLP 输出和坐标映射到预测的物理场。 对于 GNLSE 问题，预测包含两个实数分量 (u,v)；而对于 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 问题，预测则是一个单一的实数场 u。 智能体可以改变 F I F_{I} 和 F O F_{O} 的数学形式，并在 F O F_{O} 需要时增加中间 MLP 输出的维度，但不能修改其余的架构、损失函数或训练流程。 在基线方案中，F I F_{I} 将 (x,t) 原样传入 MLP，而 F O F_{O} 则返回原始的 MLP 输出。 该框架被应用于（1）的两个边界值问题——这些问题在初始条件、定义域和目标度量上有所不同——以及（6）的一个边界值问题。

paragraphs.en: The SNN classification experiments compare the standard mode, denoted the simple prompt in the result tables, with the detailed mode. The simple prompt specifies the Analyst role, classification problem, target accuracy, data-use and implementation constraints, examples of admissible decoder types, required technical-specification format, and complete experiment log. The detailed prompt adds a researcher-defined taxonomy of 12 decoder-method classes, a structured Chain-of-Thought procedure for coverage and failure analysis, an explicit class field in the technical specification, and the dynamically updated coverage map. The 12 classes define broad areas of exploration rather than 12 fixed algorithms; each class may contain multiple feature transformations, decision rules, and hyperparameter settings, and hypotheses may combine methods from different classes. The complete class taxonomy and prompt texts are provided in Supplementary Section F .

paragraphs.en: The quality reached by the framework depends both on the search performed by the LLM Analyst and on the constraints that the Human Researcher writes into the prompt. To separate these two contributions, we compare the framework with baselines that search the same space of decoders without an Analyst. All comparisons in this subsection are performed on MNIST, where the argmax baseline gives 79.88 % 79.88\,\% .
paragraphs.zh: 该框架所能达到的质量既取决于 LLM Analyst 执行的搜索，也取决于人类研究员在提示中写入的约束条件。 为了区分这两种贡献，我们将该框架与那些在没有 Analyst 的情况下对相同解码器空间进行搜索的基线模型进行比较。 本小节中的所有比较均在 MNIST 数据集上执行，其中 argmax 基线模型给出的准确率为 79.88 % 79.88\,\% 。

paragraphs.en: The decoder catalog is a fixed discrete space of estimators with grids of their hyperparameters, together with the operators that build ensembles and multistage pipelines. It is specified once as a TPOT config_dict that is listed in Supplementary Section E.2 and its classes follow the decoder taxonomy of the detailed Analyst prompt (Section 4.3 , Supplementary Materials). The Analyst prompt permits exactly the decoders contained in the catalog. The restriction reaches the systems in different ways: the agent receives it as text and can in principle depart from it, whereas the baselines receive it as a constraint on the sampler. We inspected the Experiment logs of all agent runs and found no record outside the catalog. The space of admissible decoders is therefore common to all systems, and they differ in the search strategy and in the selection protocol described below.
paragraphs.zh: 解码器目录是一个固定的离散估计器空间，其中包含其超参数的网格，以及用于构建集成和多阶段流水线的算子。 它被一次性指定为一个 TPOT config_dict，该字典列于补充材料 E.2 节中，其类遵循详细分析师提示（第 4.3 节，补充材料）中的解码器分类体系。 分析师提示仅允许目录中包含的解码器。 这一限制以不同方式作用于各个系统：智能体以文本形式接收该限制，原则上可以偏离它；而基线模型则将其作为对采样器的约束条件接收。 我们检查了所有智能体运行的实验日志，未发现任何超出目录的记录。 因此，可接受解码器的空间在所有系统中都是相同的，它们之间的差异体现在搜索策略以及下文描述的選擇协议中。

paragraphs.en: Three baseline configurations are compared with the framework, each with a budget of 250 evaluated decoders per run.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架与三种基线配置进行了比较，每种配置每次运行都使用 250 个经过评估的解码器作为预算。

paragraphs.en: Random Choice is an LLM-based sampler that draws decoder configurations from the same catalog through independent calls to Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 deployed on a rented GPU, without a Chain-of-Thought stage and without a debugging cycle. Each call receives a compressed description of the catalog and returns one decoder configuration in JSON, sampled independently of the previous choices. The configuration is implemented and evaluated by the same sandboxed pipeline as an agent hypothesis. A call that yields a configuration outside the catalog, a configuration that fails the functional test, or a repetition of a configuration already recorded is discarded and does not enter the Experiment log. Calls are issued until the Experiment log contains 250 evaluated decoders.
paragraphs.zh: Random Choice 是一种基于 LLM 的采样器，它通过独立调用部署在租用 GPU 上的 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，从同一目录中抽取解码器配置，且无需思维链阶段或调试循环。 每次调用都会接收该目录的压缩描述，并以 JSON 格式返回一个解码器配置，其采样结果与之前的选择相互独立。 该配置由与智能体假设相同的沙盒化流程进行实现和评估。 若某次调用产生的配置不在目录范围内、未能通过功能测试，或是重复了已记录的配置，则会被丢弃，不会进入实验日志。 系统将持续发出调用，直到实验日志中包含 250 个经过评估的解码器为止。

paragraphs.en: TPOT Olson et al. (2016) classic is the standard genetic algorithm with a population of 25 individuals and 9 generations, which together with the initial population gives 25 × ( 9 + 1 ) = 250 25\times(9+1)=250 evaluated candidates.
paragraphs.zh: TPOT Olson 等人 （2016）年的经典研究采用的标准遗传算法包含 25 个个体和 9 代，加上初始种群，总共评估了 25 × (9 + 1) = 250 个候选方案。

sents.en: TPOT Olson et al.
sents.zh: TPOT Olson 等人

sents.en: (2016) classic is the standard genetic algorithm with a population of 25 individuals and 9 generations, which together with the initial population gives 25 × ( 9 + 1 ) = 250 25\times(9+1)=250 evaluated candidates.
sents.zh: （2016）年的经典研究采用的标准遗传算法包含 25 个个体和 9 代，加上初始种群，总共评估了 25 × (9 + 1) = 250 个候选方案。

paragraphs.en: TPOT sequential uses a population of one individual and 249 consecutive generations, 1 × ( 249 + 1 ) = 250 1\times(249+1)=250 candidates, so that the budget is preserved while population-level exploration is replaced by a single mutating lineage.
paragraphs.zh: TPOT 序列方法使用一个个体组成的种群和 249 代连续进化，即 1 × (249 + 1) = 250 个候选解，这样既保留了预算，又用单一的突变谱系取代了种群层面的探索。

paragraphs.en: In both TPOT modes the search may combine models and build multistage processing sequences, because the corresponding operators are part of the catalog. TPOT samples and mutates pipelines according to its internal grammar, whereas Random Choice draws every configuration independently under an instruction to sample uniformly over the catalog.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种 TPOT 模式下，搜索都可以组合模型并构建多阶段处理序列，因为相应的算子都是目录的一部分。 TPOT 会根据其内部语法规则对流程进行采样和变异，而随机选择则会在均匀采样整个目录的指令下独立抽取每种配置。

sents.en: In both TPOT modes the search may combine models and build multistage processing sequences, because the corresponding operators are part of the catalog.
sents.zh: 在两种 TPOT 模式下，搜索都可以组合模型并构建多阶段处理序列，因为相应的算子都是目录的一部分。

paragraphs.en: For the framework, the budget is the number of successfully evaluated records with the OK status. Records with the With error status remain stored in the complete Experiment log but do not count toward the budget and are excluded from the filtered log view passed to the Analyst. For Random Choice, the budget is the number of successfully evaluated decoder records; invalid calls discarded as described above do not count toward it. For TPOT, the budget is the number of fitted pipelines reported by the optimizer. In every configuration the budget is 250 per run, and every configuration was run 10 times. Within one run we take the best accuracy over the 250 evaluated decoders and the position at which it was first reached; Table 3 reports the smallest and the largest of these ten per-run values.
paragraphs.zh: 对于该框架而言，预算是指成功评估且状态为“OK”的记录数量。 状态为“With error”的记录仍会存储在完整的实验日志中，但不会计入预算，也不会包含在传递给分析师的筛选后日志视图中。 对于“随机选择”，预算是指成功评估的解码器记录数量；如上所述被丢弃的无效调用不计入该预算。 对于 TPOT，预算是指优化器报告的训练好的管道数量。 在所有配置中，每次运行的预算均为 250，且每种配置均运行了 10 次。 在一次运行中，我们取 250 个已评估解码器中的最佳准确率以及首次达到该准确率时的位置；表 3 报告了这十次每次运行值中的最小值和最大值。

sents.zh: 对于该框架而言，预算是指成功评估且状态为“OK”的记录数量。

sents.zh: 在一次运行中，我们取 250 个已评估解码器中的最佳准确率以及首次达到该准确率时的位置；表 3 报告了这十次每次运行值中的最小值和最大值。

paragraphs.en: The baselines were run on the same trained SNN instances and the same output spike matrices as the prompt comparisons of Table 2 , so every baseline run is matched with the corresponding agent run and the comparison is paired. The internal scoring rules of the compared systems are not identical. In the framework and in Random Choice, a candidate is scored on a validation set formed from the training set, and the value entered in the Experiment log (for the Analyst) is the mean over three random seeds. The held-out test set is not available to the Analyst (Section 4.5 ). TPOT selects its best pipeline by mean accuracy in five-fold cross-validation on the training set, after which the selected pipeline is retrained on the entire training set and evaluated once on the test set. The comparison in Table 3 is therefore made on the test accuracy of the best decoder of a run, which is defined in the same way for all systems.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型在相同的训练 SNN 实例和相同的输出脉冲矩阵上运行，与表 2 中的提示比较使用相同的数据，因此每次基线运行都与相应的智能体运行相匹配，从而实现成对比较。 所比较系统的内部评分规则并不完全相同。 在该框架和“随机选择”中，候选项基于从训练集构成的验证集进行评分，而实验日志（分析师用）中输入的数值是三次随机种子运行结果的平均值。 预留的测试集对分析师不可用（第 4.5 节）。 TPOT 通过在训练集上进行五折交叉验证的平均准确率来选择最佳流程；随后，选定的流程会在整个训练集上重新训练，并在测试集上进行一次评估。 因此，表 3 中的比较是基于每次运行中最佳解码器的测试准确率进行的，而该准确率的定义在所有系统中均保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The specified run budget (50 for the PINN tasks and 250 for the SNN tasks) counts only successful iterations; see Section 3.1 for the iteration steps. The target metric threshold (accuracy above 90 % for MNIST and 93 % for Digits; a decrease in Rel h \mathrm{Rel}_{h} relative to the baseline for the single-soliton GNLSE problem, a decrease in Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} and Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} for the GNLSE problem with a Gaussian perturbation, and a decrease in Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} for the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky problem) provides a reference point for the analyst but is not a stopping criterion. Each hypothesis is evaluated with three random seeds in the single-soliton problem and with a single seed in the remaining two PINN problems, where one training run takes tens of minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 指定的运行预算（PINN 任务为 50，SNN 任务为 250）仅计算成功迭代；有关迭代步骤，请参见第 3.1 节。 目标指标阈值（MNIST 的准确率高于 90%，Digits 的准确率高于 93%；对于单孤子 GNLSE 问题，Rel h \mathrm{Rel}_{h} 相对于基线的下降；对于具有高斯扰动的 GNLSE 问题，Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} 和 Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} 的下降；以及对于 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 问题，Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} 的下降）为分析者提供了参考点，但并非停止准则。 在单孤子问题中，每个假设使用三个随机种子进行评估，而在其余两个 PINN 问题中则使用单个种子，其中一次训练运行需要数十分钟。

paragraphs.en: In both GNLSE problems, the baseline with identity F I , F O F_{I},F_{O} transformations is compared with three agent configurations: Perplexity Sonar ( sonar-pro ) Perplexity AI (2026) , Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 ( qwen-qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 ) Qwen Team (2025) , and Claude Opus 4.6 ( anthropic-claude-opus-4.6 ); the Analyst prompt is the same for different LLMs. Because a complete agent run for the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky problem is computationally expensive, we evaluated only Claude Opus 4.6, which produced the best results on the other tasks. The comparison for this problem is therefore limited to the Claude configuration and its baseline; different LLM models are not compared with one another. The Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 weights Qwen Team (2025) were downloaded from the model’s public repository. In the classification tasks, pairs ⟨ \langle language model, prompt ⟩ \rangle are compared: Claude Opus 4.6, Perplexity Sonar, and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, each with the simple and detailed prompts defined in Section 4.3 ; the baseline is an argmax decoder based on the output spike rates of the LIF neurons. Ablation runs with the detailed prompt and the coverage-map section removed were also performed for all three models, while retaining the method catalog and Chain-of-Thought. Accuracy comparisons are provided in Tables 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , and 18 .

paragraphs.en: To assess the effect of prompt structure, 10 complete runs, each comprising 250 iterations of agent search, were performed for every configuration. Two paired comparisons were performed for each of the three models: the simple prompt was compared with the full detailed prompt, and the detailed prompt with a coverage map was compared with its ablated version without the map. Each comparison comprised ten matched pairs of complete agent runs. Within each pair, the same trained SNN instance and identical output spike data were used, so differences between configurations were evaluated from paired differences in the maximum accuracy achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估提示结构的影响，每种配置都执行了 10 次完整运行，每次运行均包含 250 次智能体搜索迭代。 对三种模型分别进行了两两配对比较：将简单提示与完整详细提示进行比较，并将包含覆盖地图的详细提示与其移除地图后的简化版本进行比较。 每次比较均包含十对匹配的完整智能体运行结果。 在每对比较中，均使用了相同的训练好的 SNN 实例和完全一致的输出尖峰数据，因此不同配置之间的差异是通过所达到的最大准确率的配对差值进行评估的。

sents.en: Two paired comparisons were performed for each of the three models: the simple prompt was compared with the full detailed prompt, and the detailed prompt with a coverage map was compared with its ablated version without the map.

sents.en: Each comparison comprised ten matched pairs of complete agent runs.
sents.zh: 每次比较均包含十对匹配的完整智能体运行结果。

sents.en: Within each pair, the same trained SNN instance and identical output spike data were used, so differences between configurations were evaluated from paired differences in the maximum accuracy achieved.
sents.zh: 在每对比较中，均使用了相同的训练好的 SNN 实例和完全一致的输出尖峰数据，因此不同配置之间的差异是通过所达到的最大准确率的配对差值进行评估的。

paragraphs.en: For Perplexity Sonar, the difference between prompt variants was consistent across all ten runs: with the simple prompt, the maximum accuracy remained at the baseline level, whereas with the detailed prompt it exceeded 90 % in every case. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, the detailed prompt also increased the maxima relative to the baseline in all ten runs, although the magnitude of the improvement varied considerably. A paired statistical analysis over ten matched runs was performed for all three analyst models.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Perplexity Sonar，在所有十次运行中，不同提示变体的差异保持一致：使用简单提示时，最大准确率始终处于基准水平；而使用详细提示时，所有情况下的准确率都超过了 90%。 对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，详细提示在所有十次运行中也使最大值相对于基准水平有所提升，尽管改进的幅度存在显著差异。 针对全部三种分析模型，对十次匹配运行的数据进行了配对统计检验。

sents.en: A paired statistical analysis over ten matched runs was performed for all three analyst models.
sents.zh: 针对全部三种分析模型，对十次匹配运行的数据进行了配对统计检验。

paragraphs.en: The prompt effect was tested using a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test; two tests were performed for each of the three analyst models—“detailed versus simple” and “detailed versus detailed without the coverage map”—giving six tests to which the Holm correction for multiple comparisons was applied. Pairs were formed from runs with the same seed, which determines the framework initialization and the order of data presentation; in the Supplementary tables, the rows are ordered by decreasing accuracy of the detailed prompt rather than by seed number. For configurations in which the accuracy of the simple prompt exactly matched the baseline in every run, the paired test degenerates into a sign test, as reflected in the reported W W and p p values. The paired-analysis methodology and rationale for selecting the test are provided in Supplementary Section E . The unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p p values, together with the W W statistic for all six tests, are reported in Supplementary Section E ; the difference is statistically significant in all six tests at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 after the Holm correction.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词效应通过双侧精确威尔科克森符号秩检验进行了测试；针对三种分析师模型中的每种模型，分别执行了两项测试——“详细提示词与简单提示词”以及“详细提示词与不含覆盖地图的详细提示词”，共得到六项测试，并应用了霍尔姆多重比较校正。 配对由使用相同种子值运行的实验组成，该种子值决定了框架的初始化和数据呈现的顺序；在补充表格中，行是按详细提示词的准确率从高到低排序的，而非按种子编号排序。 在简单提示词的准确率与基线在所有运行中完全一致的配置中，配对检验退化为符号检验，这一点反映在报告的 W 和 p 值中。 配对分析方法以及选择该检验的理由见补充材料第 E 节。 未经校正和经霍尔姆校正的 p 值，以及全部六项测试的 W 统计量，均列于补充材料第 E 节；经过霍尔姆校正后，在 α = 0.05 时，这六项测试的差异均具有统计学显著性。

sents.en: The prompt effect was tested using a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test; two tests were performed for each of the three analyst models—“detailed versus simple” and “detailed versus detailed without the coverage map”—giving six tests to which the Holm correction for multiple comparisons was applied.
sents.zh: 提示词效应通过双侧精确威尔科克森符号秩检验进行了测试；针对三种分析师模型中的每种模型，分别执行了两项测试——“详细提示词与简单提示词”以及“详细提示词与不含覆盖地图的详细提示词”，共得到六项测试，并应用了霍尔姆多重比较校正。

sents.en: Pairs were formed from runs with the same seed, which determines the framework initialization and the order of data presentation; in the Supplementary tables, the rows are ordered by decreasing accuracy of the detailed prompt rather than by seed number.
sents.zh: 配对由使用相同种子值运行的实验组成，该种子值决定了框架的初始化和数据呈现的顺序；在补充表格中，行是按详细提示词的准确率从高到低排序的，而非按种子编号排序。

sents.en: For configurations in which the accuracy of the simple prompt exactly matched the baseline in every run, the paired test degenerates into a sign test, as reflected in the reported W W and p p values.
sents.zh: 在简单提示词的准确率与基线在所有运行中完全一致的配置中，配对检验退化为符号检验，这一点反映在报告的 W 和 p 值中。

sents.en: The paired-analysis methodology and rationale for selecting the test are provided in Supplementary Section E .
sents.zh: 配对分析方法以及选择该检验的理由见补充材料第 E 节。

sents.en: The unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p p values, together with the W W statistic for all six tests, are reported in Supplementary Section E ; the difference is statistically significant in all six tests at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 after the Holm correction.
sents.zh: 未经校正和经霍尔姆校正的 p 值，以及全部六项测试的 W 统计量，均列于补充材料第 E 节；经过霍尔姆校正后，在 α = 0.05 时，这六项测试的差异均具有统计学显著性。

paragraphs.en: The final results obtained by applying the same agent framework to five tasks are summarized in Table 1 . Accuracy (higher is better) is used for the classification tasks, whereas a relative error or physical diagnostic (lower is better) is used for the PINN tasks. The improvement over the baseline is expressed in task-specific units: for classification tasks, the absolute accuracy increase Acc − Acc base \mathrm{Acc}-\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{base}} is reported in percentage points, whereas for PINN tasks the error-reduction factor Err base / Err \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{base}}/\mathrm{Err} is reported. The accuracy values and improvements shown in the table are rounded to integers. The corresponding unrounded accuracies are 79.88 and 92.83 % for MNIST (Table 2 ) and 90.83 and 96.67 % for digits (Table 19 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将相同的智能体框架应用于五个任务后获得的最终结果汇总于表 1。 分类任务使用准确率（越高越好），而 PINN 任务则使用相对误差或物理诊断指标（越低越好）。 与基线相比的改进以任务特定的单位表示：对于分类任务，绝对准确率提升 Acc − Acc base \mathrm{Acc}-\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{base}} 以百分点报告；而对于 PINN 任务，则报告误差降低因子 Err base / Err \mathrm{Err}_{\mathrm{base}}/\mathrm{Err}。 表中所示的准确率和改进值均已四舍五入为整数。 相应的未四舍五入准确率分别为 MNIST 的 79.88% 和 92.83%（表 2），以及 digits 的 90.83% 和 96.67%（表 19）。

paragraphs.en: For the GNLSE soliton with a Gaussian perturbation, robustness was additionally evaluated over ten independent trainings. paragraphs.en: The agent configurations on MNIST are compared in Table 2 . For Claude Opus 4.6, the detailed prompt raises the mean maximum accuracy over ten runs paired by seed from 91.13 ± 0.44 % 91.13\pm 0.44\,\% to 92.15 ± 0.62 % 92.15\pm 0.62\,\% , and the best result from 91.65 % 91.65\,\% to 92.83 % 92.83\,\% . It gives the higher run maximum in eight of the ten pairs, and the two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test yields W = 5 W=5 , p = 0.0195 p=0.0195 , which remains significant after the Holm correction over the six tests of Section 4.6 . The paired gain averages 1.02 ± 0.90 1.02\pm 0.90 percentage points (Table 17 ), so for this model the effect is comparable to the spread between runs. For Perplexity Sonar and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, none of the 250 decoders proposed per run under the simple prompt outperformed the baseline, so the run maximum for both models matched the baseline of 79.88 % 79.88\,\% in all ten runs (std = 0.00 =0.00 ). The detailed prompt lifted both models above the baseline, though to different extents: for Perplexity Sonar, the individual-run maxima ranged from 90.93 % 90.93\,\% to 92.70 % 92.70\,\% with a mean of 91.76 ± 0.56 % 91.76\pm 0.56\,\% , so the 90 % 90\,\% reference point was exceeded in all ten runs, whereas for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 the mean maximum was 85.88 ± 2.42 % 85.88\pm 2.42\,\% and the best run reached 89.16 % 89.16\,\% without crossing it. For both models the prompt effect is significant by the same paired test ( W = 0 W=0 , p = 0.00195 p=0.00195 , the minimum attainable value at n = 10 n=10 ; Tables 15 and 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: MNIST 上的智能体配置在表 2 中进行了比较。 对于 Claude Opus 4.6，详细提示将十次运行（按种子配对）的平均最大准确率从 91.13 ± 0.44 % 91.13\pm 0.44\,\% 提升至 92.15 ± 0.62 % 92.15\pm 0.62\,\%，最佳结果则从 91.65 % 91.65\,\% 提升至 92.83 % 92.83\,\%。 在十对运行中，有八对的最高运行结果更高，而双侧精确威尔科克森符号秩检验得出 W = 5 W=5，p = 0.0195 p=0.0195，该结果在 4.6 节的六项检验中经过 Holm 校正后仍具有显著性。 配对增益平均为 1.02 ± 0.90 1.02\pm 0.90 个百分点（表 17），因此对于该模型，其效果与运行之间的波动相当。 对于 Perplexity Sonar 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，在简单提示下每次运行提出的 250 个解码器中，没有一个优于基线模型，因此这两个模型在所有十次运行中的最高结果均与 79.88 % 79.88\,\% 的基线一致（标准差 = 0.00 =0.00）。 详细提示使两个模型的表现都超过了基线，尽管提升程度不同：对于 Perplexity Sonar，单次运行的最高结果在 90.93 % 90.93\,\% 到 92.70 % 92.70\,\% 之间，平均为 91.76 ± 0.56 % 91.76\pm 0.56\,\%，因此十次运行均超过了 90 % 90\,\% 的参考点；而对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，平均最大值为 85.88 ± 2.42 % 85.88\pm 2.42\,\%，最佳运行结果达到 89.16 % 89.16\,\%，但未超过该参考点。 对于两个模型，通过相同的配对检验均可得出提示效果显著（W = 0 W=0，p = 0.00195 p=0.00195，在 n = 10 n=10 时可达到的最小值；表 15 和表 13）。

paragraphs.en: The Coder and the Recorder use gpt-5-mini in all configurations, at the provider’s public rate $0.25/$2.00 per M input/output tokens. For the Analyst, the rates in effect in June 2026 were $5/$25 per M input/output tokens for Claude Opus 4.6 and $1/$1 per M for Perplexity Sonar. paragraphs.en: The Coder receives its fixed prompt of 612 tokens together with the current specification and returns the Python implementation of the Decoding class; the mean length of accepted code is 4982 tokens for Claude Opus 4.6, 3749 for Perplexity Sonar, and 2513 for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. paragraphs.en: Random Choice gives the lowest token usage among the compared systems. Each mini-call contains the catalog of method classes as input and one JSON decoder configuration as output; at about 800 input and 120 output tokens per call and 347 calls per run, the run requires 0.28 M input and 0.042 M output tokens. These values are 40 and 14 times smaller than the Analyst token counts of the Qwen agent with the detailed prompt (11.20 M and 0.58 M). In accuracy the two configurations are close: the per-run maxima of Random Choice lie between 89.48 and 89.93 %, those of the Qwen agent between 82.28 and 89.16 % (Table 3 ), and neither configuration reaches the 90 % threshold. When Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 is used free of charge, C run = 0 C_{\mathrm{run}}=0 for both configurations, and they differ only in token usage and in C ∗ C^{*} . At the managed rate for this model class, the Analyst cost differs by a factor of 29 ($0.07 for Random Choice against $2.03 for the agent framework with Qwen as the LLM Analyst), and with the Coder and the Recorder included by a factor of 84 ($0.07 against $5.85, Table 4 ). Sampling of the same catalog using Random Choice method is therefore two orders of magnitude cheaper than the Qwen agent framework at comparable accuracy. Both proprietary Analysts with the detailed prompt exceed it: their minimum run maxima are 90.93 % for Perplexity Sonar and 91.22 % for Claude Opus 4.6, against 89.93 % for Random Choice. The framework is thus preferable to sampling of the same catalog when the Analyst model is sufficiently strong; for a weak Analyst, the additional cost and the additional components of the framework are not compensated by the accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在比较的系统当中，随机选择（Random Choice）的令牌使用量最低。 每次迷你调用都以方法类目录为输入，并以一个 JSON 解码器配置为输出；每次调用大约消耗 800 个输入令牌和 120 个输出令牌，每次运行包含 347 次调用，因此整个运行需要 0.28 M 输入令牌和 0.042 M 输出令牌。 这些数值比 Qwen 智能体在详细提示下的 Analyst 令牌数量分别小 40 倍和 14 倍（分别为 11.20 M 和 0.58 M）。 在准确性方面，这两种配置表现接近：随机选择的每次运行最高准确率介于 89.48% 到 89.93% 之间，而 Qwen 智能体的范围则为 82.28% 到 89.16%（见表 3），且两种配置均未达到 90% 的阈值。 当免费使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 时，两种配置的 C run = 0 C_{\mathrm{run}}=0，它们仅在令牌使用量和 C ∗ C^{*} 方面存在差异。 对于该模型类别的受管理费率，Analyst 的成本相差 29 倍（随机选择为 $0.07，而使用 Qwen 作为 LLM Analyst 的智能体框架则为 $2.03）；若将 Coder 和 Recorder 也计算在内，成本则相差 84 倍（$0.07 对比 $5.85，见表 4）。 因此，在准确性相当的情况下，使用随机选择方法对同一目录进行采样，比 Qwen 智能体框架便宜两个数量级。 两种带有详细提示的专有 Analyst 模型都优于它：Perplexity Sonar 和 Claude Opus 4.6 的每次运行最低最高准确率分别为 90.93% 和 91.22%，而随机选择仅为 89.93%。 因此，当 Analyst 模型足够强大时，使用该框架优于对同一目录进行采样；而对于较弱的 Analyst 模型，框架带来的额外成本和组件则无法通过准确性提升得到补偿。

paragraphs.en: The first PINN problem (GNLSE, α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , β = 0 \beta=0 ) has an analytical solution and therefore provides a transparent test of the framework: the agent can embed the explicit form of the one-soliton solution in the F I , F O F_{I},F_{O} blocks, and the resulting metrics reflect the correctness of such a “hinted” representation rather than an independent search for a nontrivial technique. The results are summarized in Table 5 . Because each agent run includes its own three-seed identity baseline, each reduction factor is calculated against the baseline from the same run. The best Claude Opus 4.6 hypothesis gives Rel h = 2.21 ⋅ 10 − 5 \mathrm{Rel}_{h}=2.21\cdot 10^{-5} , a 2491 2491 -fold reduction from 5.51 ⋅ 10 − 2 5.51\cdot 10^{-2} . The best sonar-pro hypothesis reduces Rel h \mathrm{Rel}_{h} from 4.69 ⋅ 10 − 2 4.69\cdot 10^{-2} to 1.97 ⋅ 10 − 4 1.97\cdot 10^{-4} ( 238 × 238\times ), while Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 reduces it from 4.85 ⋅ 10 − 2 4.85\cdot 10^{-2} to 8.86 ⋅ 10 − 3 8.86\cdot 10^{-3} ( 5.48 × 5.48\times ). Because the problem permits substitution of the analytical formula, these figures should not be interpreted as a measure of a complex search; the substantive test is deferred to the second problem.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个 PINN 问题（GNLSE，α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1，β = 0 \beta=0）具有解析解，因此为框架提供了一个透明的测试：智能体可以将单孤子解的显式形式嵌入 F I、F O F_{I},F_{O} 块中，由此产生的指标反映了这种“提示”表示的正确性，而不是对某种非平凡技术进行独立搜索的结果。 结果总结在表 5 中。 由于每次智能体运行都包含其自身的三种子身份基线，因此每个缩减因子都是基于同一运行中的基线计算的。 最佳 Claude Opus 4.6 假设给出的 Rel h = 2.21 ⋅ 10 − 5 \mathrm{Rel}_{h}=2.21\cdot 10^{-5}，相比 5.51 ⋅ 10 − 2 5.51\cdot 10^{-2} 减少了 2491 倍。 最佳 sonar-pro 假设将 Rel h \mathrm{Rel}_{h} 从 4.69 ⋅ 10 − 2 4.69\cdot 10^{-2} 降低到 1.97 ⋅ 10 − 4 1.97\cdot 10^{-4}（238 倍），而 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 则将其从 4.85 ⋅ 10 − 2 4.85\cdot 10^{-2} 降低到 8.86 ⋅ 10 − 3 8.86\cdot 10^{-3}（5.48 倍）。 由于该问题允许代入解析公式，因此不应将这些数值解释为复杂搜索能力的衡量；实质性测试将推迟到第二个问题中进行。

paragraphs.en: The best sonar-pro configuration is tw_nonlinear_pinn_core . Its F I F_{I} supplies a normalized traveling-wave coordinate, normalized time, and a local nonlinearity-density feature; F O F_{O} uses the analytical traveling-wave amplitude and phase and interprets the MLP outputs as bounded amplitude and phase corrections. The best Claude Opus 4.6 configuration, PCDS-LCC-EXP-NLOG-MIXCROSS , uses seven analytical features, including normalized and logarithmic envelopes and two amplitude–time cross-features, while F O F_{O} applies time-gated exponential amplitude and additive phase corrections with separate envelope weights. The best Qwen configuration, LogPhaseHybridNorm , normalizes the analytical soliton coordinate at the input and reconstructs the field from the analytical amplitude and carrier phase multiplied by learned complex corrections. Thus, all three best configurations exploit the known soliton structure in both the representation and the reconstruction. A detailed analysis of the hypotheses is provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 最佳声纳探测器配置为 tw_nonlinear_pinn_core。 其 F I F_{I} 提供归一化的行波坐标、归一化时间和局部非线性密度特征；F O F_{O} 则使用解析行波振幅和相位，并将 MLP 输出解释为有界的振幅和相位修正。 最佳 Claude Opus 4.6 配置 PCDS-LCC-EXP-NLOG-MIXCROSS 使用了七种解析特征，包括归一化和对数包络以及两种振幅–时间交叉特征，而 F O F_{O} 则应用了时间门控的指数振幅和加法相位修正，并配有独立的包络权重。 最佳 Qwen 配置 LogPhaseHybridNorm 在输入端对解析孤子坐标进行归一化，并通过将解析振幅和载波相位与学习到的复数修正相乘来重构场。 因此，所有三种最佳配置都在表示和重构中利用了已知的孤子结构。 假设的详细分析见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: The second PINN problem (GNLSE, α = 0.3 \alpha=0.3 , β = 0 \beta=0 ; the initial condition is a soliton with a superimposed Gaussian perturbation) has no analytical solution, so the agent cannot embed a ready-made formula and must search for a substantive representation. The search is driven by Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} ( 4 ) and Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} ; the reruns reported here do not include Rel h \mathrm{Rel}_{h} . The human-designed PINN from prior work has Res bvp = 9.11 ⋅ 10 − 5 \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}}=9.11\cdot 10^{-5} and Rel i = 9.87 ⋅ 10 − 4 \mathrm{Rel}_{i}=9.87\cdot 10^{-4} . The single-run results are summarized in Table 6 . The shared identity baseline combines the lowest Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} and the lowest Res bvp \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}} observed across the analyst runs, and each reduction factor is computed relative to its Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} . The 325 × 325\times improvement is obtained relative to the identity baseline from the same Claude Opus 4.6 run, whereas the 194 × 194\times improvement is obtained relative to the shared cross-run reference baseline. The best Claude Opus 4.6 configuration by conservation error, SPM_XPM_CorrWidth_SplitScale_HighP , reduces Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} from 1.28 ⋅ 10 − 1 1.28\cdot 10^{-1} to 6.61 ⋅ 10 − 4 6.61\cdot 10^{-4} ( 194 × 194\times ) while giving Res bvp = 3.95 ⋅ 10 − 5 \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}}=3.95\cdot 10^{-5} . A different Claude configuration, SplitAlpha_ExpPhase_HighP , gives the lowest residual, Res bvp = 2.08 ⋅ 10 − 5 \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}}=2.08\cdot 10^{-5} , with Rel i = 1.40 ⋅ 10 − 3 \mathrm{Rel}_{i}=1.40\cdot 10^{-3} . The best sonar-pro hypothesis by Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} improves this metric 20 × 20\times , but its Res bvp = 2.37 ⋅ 10 − 2 \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{bvp}}=2.37\cdot 10^{-2} is worse than the shared baseline; the best Qwen hypothesis improves Rel i \mathrm{Rel}_{i} only 1.36 × 1.36\times and likewise does not improve the baseline residual. Thus, only the Claude hypotheses improve both reported criteria substantially.

paragraphs.en: The MNIST configurations are compared in Table 2 . For Claude Opus 4.6, the detailed prompt increased the mean maximum accuracy over ten matched complete runs from 91.13 ± 0.44 % 91.13\pm 0.44\,\% to 92.15 ± 0.62 % 92.15\pm 0.62\,\% , and the best result from 91.65 % to 92.83 %. The difference between the prompt variants is confirmed by a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( W = 5 W=5 , p = 0.0195 p=0.0195 ), with the detailed prompt yielding higher accuracy in eight of ten pairs; the mean paired difference is 1.02 ± 0.90 1.02\pm 0.90 percentage points (Table 17 ), meaning that the effect is comparable in magnitude to the between-run variation.

paragraphs.en: Ten complete runs were performed with each prompt variant for Perplexity Sonar and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. With the simple prompt, none of the 250 decoders proposed per run outperformed the baseline, so the run maximum for both models exactly matched the baseline of 79.88 % in all ten cases. The detailed prompt changed the results of both models, but to different extents. The 90 % threshold was fixed before the run series as a reference point for MNIST; for the digits dataset, where the baseline is already 90.83 %, an analogous reference point was set at 93 % Section 4.5 and is not used in the tables in this section. For Perplexity Sonar, the individual-run maxima ranged from 90.93 % to 92.70 % (Table 15 ), with a mean of 91.76 ± 0.56 % 91.76\pm 0.56\,\% , so the 90 % threshold was exceeded in all ten runs. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, the mean maximum was 85.88 ± 2.42 % 85.88\pm 2.42\,\% , and the best run reached 89.16 % without exceeding the specified 90 % threshold. The difference between the prompt variants for both models is confirmed by a two-sided exact paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 Perplexity Sonar 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，每种提示变体均执行了十次完整的运行。 使用简单提示时，每次运行中提出的 250 个解码器均未超越基线模型，因此在这十次运行中，两种模型的最高得分均与 79.88% 的基线完全一致。 详细提示改变了两种模型的结果，但影响程度不同。 在运行系列开始前，已将 90% 的阈值固定为 MNIST 的参考点；对于数字数据集（其基线已达 90.83%），类似的参考点被设定为 93%（见第 4.5 节），且未用于本节的表格中。 对于 Perplexity Sonar，单次运行的最高得分在 90.93% 到 92.70% 之间（表 15），平均值为 91.76 ± 0.56%（91.76\pm 0.56\,\%），因此十次运行均超过了 90% 的阈值。 对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，最高得分的平均值为 85.88 ± 2.42%（85.88\pm 2.42\,\%），最佳运行达到了 89.16%，但未超过指定的 90% 阈值。 通过双侧精确配对威尔科克森符号秩检验，证实了两种提示变体在两个模型上的差异具有显著性。

paragraphs.en: The ablation experiment excluding the coverage map was performed for all three analyst models (Tables 14 , 16 , and 18 ). For Claude Opus 4.6, removing the map reduces the mean maximum to 91.02 ± 0.25 % 91.02\pm 0.25\,\% , which is 1.14 1.14 percentage points below the detailed prompt ( 92.15 % 92.15\,\% ) and nearly matches the level of the simple prompt ( 91.13 % 91.13\,\% ). All ten runs nevertheless retain accuracy above 90 %, indicating that the coverage map has little effect on the result for the strong model. For Perplexity Sonar, removing the map reduces the mean maximum to 82.34 ± 0.70 % 82.34\pm 0.70\,\% ( Δ = 9.42 \Delta=9.42 percentage points), and no run reaches the threshold. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, the mean maximum falls to 80.18 ± 0.45 % 80.18\pm 0.45\,\% ( Δ = 5.70 \Delta=5.70 percentage points), effectively returning to the baseline level of 79.88 %: the coverage map proves to be the key component that enabled this model to improve over the baseline argmax decoder (the class label is assigned by the neuron with the highest spike rate).
paragraphs.zh: 针对所有三种分析模型，进行了排除覆盖地图的消融实验（表 14、16 和 18）。 对于 Claude Opus 4.6，移除地图后平均最大值降至 91.02 ± 0.25 % 91.02\pm 0.25\,\%，比详细提示（92.15 % 92.15\,\%）低 1.14 个百分点，且几乎与简单提示的水平（91.13 % 91.13\,\%）一致。 尽管如此，所有十次运行仍保持高于 90 % 的准确率，表明覆盖地图对该强大模型的结果影响甚微。 对于 Perplexity Sonar，移除地图后平均最大值降至 82.34 ± 0.70 % 82.34\pm 0.70\,\%（Δ = 9.42 \Delta=9.42 个百分点），且没有任何一次运行达到阈值。 对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，平均最大值降至 80.18 ± 0.45 % 80.18\pm 0.45\,\%（Δ = 5.70 \Delta=5.70 个百分点），实际上回到了 79.88 % 的基线水平：覆盖地图被证明是使该模型优于基线 argmax 解码器的关键组件（类别标签由突触率最高的神经元分配）。

paragraphs.en: The experiments show that prompt detail can partially compensate for the limitations of the analyst model, although the degree of compensation depends on the LLM used. Claude Opus 4.6 achieves accuracy above 90 % with both prompt variants. With the simple prompt, Perplexity Sonar remains at the baseline level in all ten complete runs, but with the detailed prompt it consistently exceeds 90 % and reaches the level of Claude Opus 4.6. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, the detailed prompt also produces a substantial gain: the best result increases from 79.88 % to 89.16 %. At the same time, the higher variability of the maxima ( 85.88 ± 2.42 % 85.88\pm 2.42\,\% ) and the absence of any run with a maximum accuracy above 90 % show that the instruction structure does not fully compensate for the limitations of this model. When search cost is taken into account (Table 4 ), the advantage of Claude Opus 4.6 also persists in economic terms: despite the highest cost per run ($98 versus $16 for Sonar), it reaches its best decoder after only k min = 2 k_{\min}=2 to k max = 43 k_{\max}=43 evaluated candidates (Table 3 ), which makes the cost of reaching the best result comparable to that of Sonar ($0.37 versus $0.21), whereas Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, deployed on a rented GPU, costs less than both proprietary models ($5.90 per run at the managed rate for the same model class, with the Analyst alone contributing $2.00) but still fails to reach the target threshold over the full run.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，提示词的细节可以在一定程度上弥补分析模型的限制，尽管这种补偿的程度取决于所使用的 LLM。 Claude Opus 4.6 在两种提示词变体下均实现了超过 90% 的准确率。 使用简单提示词时，Perplexity Sonar 在所有十次完整运行中均停留在基准水平，但使用详细提示词后，其准确率稳定超过 90%，并达到了 Claude Opus 4.6 的水平。 对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，详细提示词也带来了显著提升：最佳结果从 79.88% 提高到了 89.16%。 同时，最大值的更高变异性（85.88 ± 2.42%）以及没有任何一次运行能达到超过 90% 的最大准确率，表明指令结构并未完全弥补该模型的限制。 当考虑搜索成本时（表 4），Claude Opus 4.6 在经济性方面同样保持优势：尽管每次运行的成本最高（Sonar 为 16 美元，而其为 98 美元），但它仅需评估 k_min = 2 到 k_max = 43 个候选项（表 3）即可达到最佳解码器，这使得达到最佳结果的成本与 Sonar 相当（0.37 美元对 0.21 美元）；而部署在租用 GPU 上的 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 成本低于两款专有模型（相同模型类别的管理费率下每次运行仅需 5.90 美元，其中 Analyst 部分就占 2.00 美元），但在完整运行中仍未能达到目标阈值。

paragraphs.en: In every task, the agent finds a technique tied to the physics of the problem: class-conditional spike-rate statistics for the CCN, the soliton structure of the solution for the Schrödinger equation, and a phase-separated representation of the pulse–perturbation interaction for the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation. The second PINN problem (a soliton with a Gaussian perturbation) is particularly informative: its analytical solution is unknown, so the gain cannot be reduced to substituting a ready-made formula, and the best configuration (Claude Opus 4.6) improves the conservation of the integrals of motion by more than an order of magnitude. In the KS problem, the improvement appears in a different physical diagnostic, namely mass drift. All five experiments are nevertheless handled by the same framework without changes to its internal structure.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个任务中，智能体都会找到一种与问题物理特性相关的技术：对于 CCN，是类别条件尖峰率统计；对于薛定谔方程，是解的孤子结构；而对于 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 方程，则是脉冲–扰动相互作用的相分离表示。 第二个 PINN 问题（一个带有高斯扰动的孤子）尤其具有启发性：其解析解尚不明确，因此增益无法简化为代入现成公式，而最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6）将运动积分的守恒性提升了超过一个数量级。 在 KS 问题中，改进体现在另一种物理诊断指标上，即质量漂移。 尽管如此，所有五个实验都由同一框架处理，且无需对其内部结构进行任何修改。

paragraphs.en: Despite the results reported above, the present study has several limitations that should be taken into account when interpreting the findings and when comparing our system with alternative approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管上述报告了研究结果，但本研究仍存在若干局限性，在解读研究结果以及将我们的系统与替代方法进行比较时，应予以考虑。

paragraphs.en: Restricted search space. The agent modifies a fixed catalogue of editable blocks (encoders, neuron models, connectivity schemes for SNNs; loss weights, activation functions and sampling strategies for PINNs). Structural transformations that fall outside this catalogue – for example, adding auxiliary networks or replacing the entire training paradigm – cannot be discovered by the current agent and would require an extended action space.
paragraphs.zh: 受限的搜索空间。 智能体修改一个固定的可编辑模块目录（对于 SNN，包括编码器、神经元模型和连接方案；对于 PINN，包括损失权重、激活函数和采样策略）。 超出该目录范围的结构变换——例如添加辅助网络或替换整个训练范式——无法被当前智能体发现，需要扩展动作空间才能实现。

paragraphs.en: Flat experiment log without a hypothesis graph. The Recorder stores runs as a chronological JSON log; it does not maintain a directed acyclic graph of hypotheses and their dependencies. As a consequence, the Analyst re-derives relations between experiments from the log at every step, which limits the depth of multi-step reasoning that can be sustained over long sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 没有假设图的扁平化实验日志。 记录器以按时间顺序排列的 JSON 日志形式存储运行过程；它不会维护一个包含假设及其依赖关系的有向无环图。 因此，分析员在每一步都需要根据日志重新推导出实验之间的关系，这限制了在长时间会话中能够维持的多步推理深度。

paragraphs.en: Bounded number of iterations. All reported runs are capped at 250 250 iterations for SNN tasks and 50 50 iterations for PINN tasks. These bounds were chosen to keep the wall-clock cost reproducible within the budgets reported in Table 4 , but they also mean that the accuracy and relative-error values in Sections 5.2 , 5.4 , 5.5 and 5.6 are lower bounds on what the agent can eventually reach with a larger budget.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代次数有限。 所有报告的运行中，SNN 任务的迭代次数上限为 250 次，PINN 任务的迭代次数上限为 50 次。 选择这些上限是为了确保在表 4 中报告的时间预算内，实际运行时间具有可重复性；但这也意味着第 5.2、5.4、5.5 和 5.6 节中的准确率和相对误差值，是智能体在更大预算下最终可达到的性能的下限。

paragraphs.en: To date, automatic tuning of neural networks has been carried out mainly within the framework of an allocated single metric of the given competition: agent-based systems optimize the entire ML script, NAS approaches search over architectures according to accuracy, and PINN frameworks train networks to minimize the relative error. For tasks whose quality is defined by a multidimensional signal—by the conservation of a set of physical invariants or by additional structural requirements—frameworks of a different class are required. The results reported in this paper demonstrate the robustness and generalization ability of the proposed multi-agent framework, which consists of an analyst, a programmer, and a recorder, together with a sandboxed execution environment and an experiment log serving as external memory, on tasks of different nature without changes to its internal structure.
paragraphs.zh: 迄今为止，神经网络的自动调优主要在给定竞赛中指定的单一指标框架内进行：智能体系统会优化整个机器学习脚本，NAS 方法会根据准确性搜索不同架构，而 PINN 框架则会训练网络以最小化相对误差。 对于其质量由多维信号定义的任务——例如通过一组物理不变量的守恒或额外的结构要求来定义——则需要另一类框架。 本文报告的结果表明，所提出的多智能体框架具有稳健性和泛化能力。该框架由一名分析员、一名程序员和一名记录员组成，并配有沙盒执行环境和作为外部存储的实验日志，能够在不同性质的任务上运行，而无需改变其内部结构。

sents.zh: 本文报告的结果表明，所提出的多智能体框架具有稳健性和泛化能力。该框架由一名分析员、一名程序员和一名记录员组成，并配有沙盒执行环境和作为外部存储的实验日志，能够在不同性质的任务上运行，而无需改变其内部结构。

paragraphs.en: The same unchanged framework was applied to five tasks with different types of information representation: accuracy increased from 79.88 % to 92.83 % on MNIST and from 90.83 % to 96.67 % on digits ; in the single-soliton PINN problem, the relative amplitude error decreased by a factor of approximately 2491; in the more complex problem with a Gaussian perturbation and no known analytical solution, the conservation error of the integrals of motion decreased by a factor of approximately 325 in the selected run and by factors of 116 and 103, respectively, based on the mean errors over ten additional trainings of the residual-selected and invariant-selected configurations (Table 11 ); and in the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky problem, the boundary-value-problem residual decreased by a factor of 9.3 and mass drift by a factor of 14 (Tables 1 and 7 ). A separate result concerns the interaction between the analyst model and prompt structure. On MNIST, the detailed prompt enabled Perplexity Sonar to exceed 90 % accuracy in all ten complete runs and to reach a maximum of 92.70 %, close to the result of Claude Opus 4.6. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, maximum accuracy increased from the baseline level of 79.88 % to 89.16 %, but the target threshold was not reached. Prompt design can therefore substantially improve the performance of a less capable LLM, but only partially compensates for differences between models.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的未变更框架被应用于五个具有不同信息表示类型的任务：在 MNIST 数据集上，准确率从 79.88% 提升至 92.83%，在 digits 数据集上则从 90.83% 提升至 96.67%；在单孤子 PINN 问题中，相对振幅误差降低了约 2491 倍；在包含高斯扰动且无已知解析解的更复杂问题中，运动积分的守恒误差在所选运行中降低了约 325 倍，而根据残差选择配置和不变量选择配置的十次额外训练的平均误差计算，该误差分别降低了 116 倍和 103 倍（表 11）；在 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 问题中，边界值问题的残差降低了 9.3 倍，质量漂移则降低了 14 倍（表 1 和表 7）。 另一项独立的结果涉及分析模型与提示结构之间的相互作用。 在 MNIST 数据集上，详细的提示使 Perplexity Sonar 在所有十次完整运行中均实现了超过 90% 的准确率，最高可达 92.70%，接近 Claude Opus 4.6 的结果。 对于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，最大准确率从基准水平的 79.88% 提升至 89.16%，但仍未达到目标阈值。 因此，提示设计可以显著提升能力较弱的 LLM 的性能，但仅能部分弥补不同模型之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Future work includes increasing the complexity of the PINN problem (the interaction of two solitons and other regimes without analytical solutions), jointly tuning several blocks (the decoder and plasticity rules for the SNN), and constructing models that account for the constraints of neuromorphic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作包括提高 PINN 问题的复杂性（两个孤子的相互作用以及其他没有解析解的情况）、联合调整多个模块（SNN 的解码器和可塑性规则），以及构建能够考虑神经形态系统约束的模型。

paragraphs.en: The Correlation Classwise Network (CCN) Sboev et al. (2025) ; Kunitsyn et al. (2025) was selected as the baseline model. Its architecture, input encoding, supervisory-signal delivery, and plasticity rule are adopted without modification; the agent’s modifications are restricted to the output-spike-activity decoder. Input expansion using Gaussian receptive fields (GRF) and the bagging ensemble Rybka et al. (2024) are not used because preliminary experiments on MNIST showed no appreciable gain.
paragraphs.zh: Correlation Classwise Network（CCN）Sboev 等人（2025）；Kunitsyn 等人 （2025）被选为基线模型。 其架构、输入编码、监督信号传递和可塑性规则均未经修改地采用；智能体的修改仅限于输出尖峰活动解码器。 使用高斯感受野（GRF）的输入扩展以及 Rybka 等人（2024） 提出的 bagging 集成方法未被采用，因为对 MNIST 的初步实验显示其没有明显提升。

paragraphs.en: The approach is applied to two datasets: MNIST ( 28 × 28 28\times 28 , N = 784 N=784 spike generators) and the scikit-learn digits Pedregosa et al. (2011) ( 8 × 8 8\times 8 , N = 64 N=64 ). Both have ten classes, pixel values are normalized by the L 1 L_{1} norm of the input vector, and the number of output LIF neurons is K = 10 K=10 . The network has two layers: the input layer contains N N spike generators, and the output layer contains K K Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons; the connections are fully connected and trainable, with no lateral connections.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the observed improvements are robust to random initialization, we repeated the training procedure for the GNLSE problem with a Gaussian perturbation. We compared the baseline model with two agent-designed configurations: one selected for its low equation residual and the other for its accurate preservation of the physical invariant. Each configuration was successfully trained ten times. Because the random initializations were not matched across configurations, the resulting samples were treated as independent rather than paired. Table 11 summarizes the results.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估观察到的改进是否对随机初始化具有鲁棒性，我们对 GNLSE 问题采用高斯扰动重复了训练过程。 我们将基准模型与两种由智能体设计的配置进行了比较：一种因其方程残差低而被选中，另一种则因其能准确保留物理不变量而被选中。 每种配置都成功训练了十次。 由于不同配置之间的随机初始化并未匹配，因此所得样本被视为独立的，而非成对的。 表 11 总结了这些结果。

sents.en: Table 11 summarizes the results.
sents.zh: 表 11 总结了这些结果。

paragraphs.en: Both agent-designed configurations reduce the invariant error by more than two orders of magnitude on average relative to the baseline. The residual-selected configuration has a slightly lower mean error and coefficient of variation, although the two distributions overlap substantially. In the original search, the invariant-selected configuration achieved an error of 6.61 ⋅ 10 − 4 6.61\cdot 10^{-4} , lower than in any of its ten subsequent retrainings. By contrast, the original error of the residual-selected configuration, 1.40 ⋅ 10 − 3 1.40\cdot 10^{-3} , is close to its repeated-run mean. This contrast indicates a selection effect: the best result found during a search can be more favorable than the performance typically obtained when the same configuration is retrained.
paragraphs.zh: 两种由智能体设计的配置，与基线相比，平均而言都将不变量误差降低了两个数量级以上。 残差选择配置的均值误差和变异系数略低，尽管这两种分布存在显著重叠。 在原始搜索中，不变量选择配置的误差达到了 6.61 ⋅ 10 − 4 6.61\cdot 10^{-4}，低于其后十次重新训练中的任何一次结果。 相比之下，残差选择配置的原始误差为 1.40 ⋅ 10 − 3 1.40\cdot 10^{-3}，接近其重复运行后的均值。 这种对比表明存在一种选择效应：在搜索过程中找到的最佳结果可能优于同一配置在重新训练时通常能达到的性能。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate coverage map of decoder method classes from the complete 250-iteration log for the ⟨ \langle Perplexity Sonar, detailed prompt ⟩ \rangle configuration on MNIST is presented in Table 12 . Each valid decoder is assigned to one principal class according to the substance of its decision rule, while decoders that explicitly aggregate several predictions are grouped in the “Ensembles” row. paragraphs.en: In the best configuration (Claude Opus 4.6, detailed prompt), the 92.83 % result was obtained by a hybrid method: class-averaged representations serve as centroids, and the decision is based on Mahalanobis distance with class-specific covariance. The pattern is the same for Perplexity Sonar with the detailed prompt: the best decoders belong to LDA/QDA and prototype method classes. These classes use the entire output spike-rate vector, whereas the baseline argmax uses only one of its components. The ablation confirms the role of the coverage map: when it is removed (while the catalog of method classes and Chain-of-Thought are retained), Perplexity Sonar does not reach 90 % during a run, and the best accuracy falls from 92.70 % to 83.18 %; the analyst converges on a narrow set of similar ensemble variations.
paragraphs.zh: 在最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6，详细提示）中，通过一种混合方法获得了 92.83% 的结果：使用类均值的表示作为中心点，并基于带类特定协方差的马氏距离做出决策。 Perplexity Sonar 在使用详细提示时呈现出相同的模式：最佳解码器属于 LDA/QDA 和原型方法类别。 这些类别使用了完整的输出尖峰率向量，而基线 argmax 仅使用其其中一个分量。 消融实验证实了覆盖图的作用：当移除覆盖图（同时保留方法类别目录和思维链）时，Perplexity Sonar 在一次运行中无法达到 90%，最佳准确率从 92.70% 下降至 83.18%；分析者最终收敛到一组相似的集成变体。

paragraphs.en: For each model, the statistical significance of differences between the two configurations was assessed using a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired samples. The null hypothesis stated that neither compared configuration had a systematic advantage: the paired accuracy differences were centered at zero. The alternative hypothesis assumed a systematic difference between the configurations. The test was applied under the assumption of a symmetric distribution of paired differences. For the two-sided test, the W W statistic was defined as the smaller of the rank sums for positive and negative nonzero differences. The significance level was set to α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .

paragraphs.en: The same framework was applied to digits 8 × 8 8\times 8 ; the run design was the same as for MNIST. The baseline argmax decoder gives an accuracy of 90.83 %, whereas the best ⟨ \langle Claude Opus 4.6, detailed prompt ⟩ \rangle configuration increases it to 96.67 % (Table 19 ). The best decoder uses a nonparametric generative classifier based on KDE with a Gaussian kernel in a PCA subspace, and the label is determined using the Bayes rule c ^ = arg ⁡ max c ​ [ log ⁡ p ⁡ ( f ∣ c ) + log ⁡ p ⁡ ( c ) ] \hat{c}=\arg\max_{c}[\log p(f\mid c)+\log p(c)] ; hyperparameters were selected using 5-fold cross-validation.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的框架也应用于 8 × 8 的数字；运行设计与 MNIST 的相同。 基线 argmax 解码器的准确率为 90.83%，而最佳 ⟨ \langle Claude Opus 4.6，详细提示 ⟩ \rangle 配置将其提升至 96.67%（表 19）。 最佳解码器使用一种基于 KDE 的非参数生成分类器，该分类器在 PCA 子空间中采用高斯核函数，标签则通过贝叶斯规则 c ^ = arg ⁡ max c ​ [ log ⁡ p ⁡ ( f ∣ c ) + log ⁡ p ⁡ ( c ) ] \hat{c}=\arg\max_{c}[\log p(f\mid c)+\log p(c)] 确定；超参数通过 5 折交叉验证进行选择。
